items.title: Osaka public university: ~500 servers down, backups encrypted
items.summary: An October 2 attack breached the university's virtualization infrastructure, forced nearly 500 servers offline and encrypted many backups; personal data of up to 130,000 students and alumni may sit on affected systems (institution name varies across reports).

items.title: DexCom claimed by Redact group
items.summary: The Redact group listed US medical-device maker DexCom (~$4.97B revenue) on its leak site on October 10; the claim is unverified.

items.title: Andersen Group hit by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: Professional-services firm Andersen Group was posted on October 6 as a SilentRansomGroup victim, with reported system disruption and payment demands; leak-site based, unconfirmed by the company.

items.title: Fake 'data deletion' service is a double-extortion scheme
items.summary: ThaiCERT warns that a group offering to help victims delete stolen data is itself running a double-extortion operation against those who engage.

ransomware.note: Two further SilentRansomGroup postings (Oct 5, Oct 7) show only partial victim names and are omitted.

items.title: Reddit outage hits 11,600+ users
items.summary: Downdetector logged more than 11,600 Reddit problem reports by 12:56 p.m. PT on Wednesday, October 14.

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex performance incident
items.summary: OpenAI's status history shows an October 14 incident of slow responses and streaming failures across ChatGPT and Codex, resolved at 09:53 UTC.

items.title: Discord access and notification issues across US, DE, UK
items.summary: Users reported unreachable service in the US, broken notifications in Germany and role-management errors in the UK on October 14; no confirmed platform-wide outage.

items.title: Astound broadband DNS and connectivity problems
items.summary: Astound customers filed 554 outage reports in 24 hours as of October 13, citing DNS errors and hours of downtime.

outage.note: No AWS, Azure or Google Cloud hyperscaler outage found for October 2026; items are SaaS/ISP disruptions from user-report trackers.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day exploited for credential theft
items.summary: CISA added an Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass to KEV on October 13 and urged immediate patching, warning it allows unauthenticated remote command execution used for credential theft and exfiltration.

items.title: CISA adds PAN-OS, Cisco Secure Email and Ahsay flaws to KEV
items.summary: Four actively exploited vulnerabilities were added on October 14, covering Palo Alto PAN-OS, Cisco Secure Email Gateway and two AhsayCBS backup-server flaws, notable for BCDR teams running Ahsay.

items.title: Flax Typhoon exploiting five flaws; federal deadline set
items.summary: Five vulnerabilities tied to Chinese state actor Flax Typhoon were added to KEV with an October 11 remediation deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: Denmark Central Person Register: ~8.8M records exposed
items.summary: Danish officials say unauthorized parties abused access granted to a private supplier, exposing names, addresses and ID numbers of about 8.8 million people.

items.title: Technical University of Denmark IAM systems breached
items.summary: DTU found unauthorized access to its identity and access management systems and large-scale data exfiltration affecting up to 200,000 people.

items.title: ASOS confirms breach after rogue app push notifications
items.summary: The retailer confirmed a breach after attackers sent unauthorized push notifications through its mobile app while claiming to hold customer data.

items.title: iRhythm discloses unauthorized access to patient data
items.summary: Cardiac-monitoring firm iRhythm Holdings disclosed a cybersecurity incident involving access to certain patient data; investigation ongoing.

items.title: Frontline Education breached via third-party software flaw
items.summary: Frontline Education is notifying school districts after attackers exploited a vulnerability in third-party software to access its systems.

items.title: M 7.7 earthquake near Pitaloza Arriba, Panama
items.summary: USGS orange-alert event on October 9, followed by M 6.6 (tsunami flag, yellow alert) and M 6.1 aftershocks near Río Grande through October 12.

items.title: M 6.8 and M 6.7 earthquakes, central Mid-Atlantic Ridge
items.summary: A pair of offshore quakes on October 13; the M 6.8 carried a tsunami flag, green alert with minimal impact expected.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias landfall near Destin, Florida
items.summary: Isaias came ashore on the northern Gulf Coast as a Category 2 (around Oct 9–10) before weakening, damaging trailer homes in Escambia County and prompting rescues in Milton.

items.title: Hurricane Simon floods western Mexico
items.summary: Simon brought life-threatening flooding and mudslide risk to western Mexico; five deaths attributed to tropical systems as it weakened to Category 1 on October 13.

items.title: Tropical Storm Rachel floods Palm Springs and Nevada
items.summary: Overnight heavy rain flooded Palm Springs and closed Indian Canyon; Southwest flood advisories were mostly lifted by October 13.

items.title: Yosemite Dome Fire reaches 86% containment
items.summary: Containment rose to 86% on October 13, with command returning to Yosemite National Park on October 15.

physical.note: Hurricane Fausto is tracking toward Hawaii; watch NHC/CPHC for impact forecasts.
